title: Starbucks Reserve
description: Three animals. Three coffee-growing regions. A collection of intricately layered sculptures created for Starbucks Reserve at SM North Towers, Quezon City. The Sumatran tiger, Kenyan elephant, and Guatemalan quetzal translate the origins of coffee into pattern, texture, and relief.
context: Created for the Reserve store at SM North Towers. This installation translates the visual language of paper cutting into layered MDF for a lasting architectural display.
sources: The Starbucks Reserve commission · adobo magazine

captions.74: Patrick Cabral with the Starbucks Reserve collection

title: Langit at Lupa
description: Two elaborate masks inspired by the energy and ornament of Dinagyang. Langit evokes air, flight, and dreams; Lupa evokes earth, fire, and passion. Together, they explore the meeting of calm and chaos.
alt: Langit at Lupa by Patrick Cabral
context: Commissioned by the Iloilo Museum of Contemporary Art for the Dinagyang Festival. The pair is part of Mananayaw ng Langit at Lupa, or Dancers of Heaven and Earth.

title: Roosters in Colour
description: Two roosters meet in an expansive composition of colour and movement. Layered feathers open into rhythmic fans, transforming a charged encounter into an intricate sculptural silhouette.
alt: Roosters in Colour by Patrick Cabral

title: Parol
description: A familiar Filipino symbol becomes an elaborate study in symmetry. Jewel-like colour and repeated patterns radiate outward from a central star.

title: Parol II
description: A second exploration of the star-shaped Filipino lantern. Concentric layers of blue, yellow, pink, and green gather around the centre, creating depth through colour and repetition.

title: Fudog
description: An expressive guardian face, built from vivid interlocking shapes. Curls, flames, and repeating contours create a dense surface of sculptural ornament.

title: Roosters in White
description: An encounter suspended in motion. Two birds rise through a composition of outstretched wings and cascading tails, each feather articulated through delicate layers and repeating patterns.
alt: Roosters in White by Patrick Cabral

title: Crowned Lion
description: A regal feline portrait framed by an elaborate mane and crown. Fine ornamental contours give the white and gold layers a lace-like delicacy.

title: Elephant
description: A frontal elephant portrait shaped by patterned layers. Wide ears, curled tusks, and a sweeping trunk turn an instantly recognisable animal into an intricate arrangement of curves.

title: Tiger
description: A tiger portrait articulated through delicate white layers and dark outlines. The close views reveal how repeated patterns give structure to the cheeks, brows, and muzzle.

title: Tiger in Blue
description: A feline portrait surrounded by a radiating blue silhouette. Cool colour and layered pattern give this tiger a distinct expression and rhythm.
alt: Tiger in Blue by Patrick Cabral

title: Tiger in Gold
description: A white tiger portrait traced with fine gold contours. Repeating arches follow the face and build a layered relief around its eyes and muzzle.
alt: Tiger in Gold by Patrick Cabral

title: Lion
description: An expressive lion portrait framed by a mane of overlapping, petal-like forms. An installation photograph places the layered sculpture in its architectural setting.

title: Lion / Openwork
description: Open contours and pointed shapes form a sweeping mane. This lion explores the contrast between a solid face and the delicate outer silhouette of its ornament.

title: Rhinoceros in White
description: A sculptural rhinoceros with a surface of repeated, lace-like detail. White layers follow the full body, bringing delicate patterns to a powerful animal silhouette.
alt: Rhinoceros in White by Patrick Cabral

title: Dhole
description: An alert wild-dog portrait rendered in fine white layers. A dense field of cut detail follows the face while the ears establish a crisp, recognisable outline.

title: Gorilla
description: A quiet portrait with a richly patterned surface. Overlapping layers define the brow, muzzle, and outline of a gorilla’s face.

title: Iberian Lynx
description: Tufted ears and a long facial silhouette become a framework for layered ornament. Curving motifs move across the face, drawing attention toward the eyes.

title: Tamaraw
description: The curved horns and broad face of a tamaraw become a symmetrical layered portrait. Fine patterns gather around the eyes and flow outward across its silhouette.

title: Hippopotamus
description: A broad, rounded animal portrait built from repeated contours. Gold accents and fine white patterning bring rhythm to the face.

title: Dog Portrait
description: A white dog portrait with soft, floppy ears and an intricately patterned face. A small collar tag brings a personal detail to the layered composition.

title: Cat
description: A cat’s face emerges from intricately layered white ornament. Clear eyes and pointed ears anchor a surface of delicate repeating motifs.

title: Owl
description: An owl rendered in a dark, densely patterned relief. Its upright silhouette and luminous eyes remain distinct within a finely detailed surface.

title: Bee
description: An insect becomes a sculptural study in symmetry. Delicate open wings extend from a richly patterned body, revealing the relationship between structure and ornament.

title: Eagle
description: An eagle held in a moment of movement, with lifted wings and sharply defined feathers. Layers of white detail give the silhouette both volume and delicacy.

title: Penguin
description: A patterned white penguin framed by deep, stepped layers. Two views show the figure against warm red and amber backgrounds.

title: Cockatoo
description: A crested bird perched on a branch. Layers of pale ornament articulate the feathers, while its lifted crest creates an expressive profile.

title: Horses
description: Two white horses stretch through a flowing, horizontal composition. Layered surface detail follows their bodies, balancing movement with intricate repetition.

title: Shark
description: A white shark suspended within a framed composition. Its long, recognisable silhouette is filled with carefully arranged surface detail.

title: Pangolin
description: A curled animal figure forms an almost circular composition. Its repeated scale-like layers make texture the central structure of the work.

title: White & Gold Dragon
description: A long white dragon moves across a horizontal composition. Gold details accent the curling body, horns, and limbs, drawing the eye along its patterned surface.
alt: White & Gold Dragon by Patrick Cabral

title: Intertwined Dragons
description: Two dragons weave through a single expansive composition. Their curving bodies and fine surface patterns create a conversation between movement and balance.

title: Dragon & Serpent
description: A dragon and a serpent face one another in a curling composition. White and gold layers articulate their bodies and give shape to the space between them.

title: Dragon & Fish
description: A pale dragon and surrounding fish move over a warm gold ground. Interwoven silhouettes form a flowing composition of water, motion, and ornament.

title: Golden Dragon
description: A golden dragon stretches across the composition in a series of flowing curves. Fine repeating detail follows the length of the body and reaches into the smallest features.

title: Winged Figures
description: Two winged figures meet in a cloud-like arrangement of curves. Layered surfaces give shape to the bodies, feathers, and surrounding relief.

title: Figure in Motion
description: A pale figure rises above a sweeping red form. Fine ornament and an elongated silhouette create a theatrical sense of motion.
alt: Figure in Motion by Patrick Cabral

title: Madonna & Child
description: A crowned mother and child framed by a delicate radiating halo. Ornamental layers shape the sweeping robes, moving between gold, white, blue, and warm red.

title: Dragon & Koi
description: A dragon and fish weave through an intricate square composition. White and gold layers intertwine against a dark ground.

title: Architecture in Relief
description: A classical building reimagined through layers of white ornament. Detail photographs move from the full façade into the architectural rhythm of columns, windows, and decorative edges.
alt: Architecture in Relief by Patrick Cabral

title: Darth Vader
description: An iconic dark helmet translated into layered ornament. Fine surface detail follows its familiar curves and angular contours.

title: Wolf Characters
description: Two playful wolf portraits pair layered faces with stylised streetwear. Coloured caps and jackets give each character a distinct personality.

title: Ornamental Creature
description: A seated fantastical creature with a curled tail and highly patterned surface. Sweeping contours and delicate ornament give the compact sculpture an expressive silhouette.

title: Primate Portrait
description: An expressive primate portrait with warm earth tones and a vividly coloured face. Repeated contours build outward into a broad, symmetrical silhouette.

title: Lettering in Relief
description: Bold lettering surrounded by a dense arrangement of botanical ornament. White layers and deep shadows set the directness of the word against the delicacy of its sculptural setting.
alt: Ornamental white layered sculpture spelling FUCK by Patrick Cabral

title: White Lettering
description: A typographic composition built from close-set white layers. Letterforms sit within a field of repeated contours, creating a quiet interplay of language and relief.

title: Calligraphic Monogram
description: A flowing monogram rendered in vivid turquoise and green. Sweeping letterforms bring the movement of calligraphy into a dimensional composition.

title: Faceted Vessel
description: A vessel study shaped by closely stacked contours and a faceted opening. Alternate views reveal the changing rhythm of the rim and outer surface.

title: Lattice Form
description: An open ovoid structure with a metallic finish. Interconnected cells define a form through its empty spaces as much as through its surface.

title: Organic Forms
description: Flowing white forms with deep openings and layered surface rhythms. These related studies explore the balance between a continuous outer shape and its internal spaces.

title: Chromatic Form
description: An ovoid study animated by flowing bands of colour. A full view and close-up reveal the intricate paths that weave across and through its surface.

title: Branching Tree
description: A digital study of branching structure. Fine lines accumulate into a tree-like form, exploring growth through repeated divisions.

title: Branching Figure
description: The human silhouette interpreted as a network of fine branching paths. Two treatments explore the relationship between organic growth and circuit-like structure.

title: Twisting Forms
description: A pair of twisting forms built from stacked ribs. Repeated elements create fluid silhouettes that change in density and direction.

title: Tower Studies
description: Two slender towers shaped by stacked, shifting layers. Their changing profiles explore how repetition can suggest movement within a static form.

title: Chair Studies
description: Two chairs explored as continuous, sculptural gestures. Looping profiles blur the boundary between furniture and expressive line.

title: Pattern Field
description: An all-over study of interlocking colour and repeating motifs. The close composition explores pattern as a continuous field rather than a single central object.

title: Chromatic Mask
description: A mask-like face formed from vivid geometric marks against a dark ground. Dense colour and rhythmic line create a distinctly graphic portrait.

title: Paired Eagles
description: Two eagles face one another with wings lifted. Fine patterned feathers create a mirrored composition, balancing the birds with the open space between them.

title: Rhinoceros in Gold
description: A warm gold-toned rhinoceros with an elaborately patterned surface. Repeated contours follow the animal’s body, tracing the broad silhouette and distinctive horns.
alt: Rhinoceros in Gold by Patrick Cabral

title: Peacock
description: A crested bird with a long, broad tail. Layered pattern gives depth to the feathers and follows the elegant outline of the body.

title: Hornbill
description: A hornbill perched on a branch, its distinctive beak and casque forming a striking profile. Fine layered detail continues across the wings and body.

title: Stormtrooper
description: A familiar white science-fiction helmet interpreted through delicate sculptural pattern. The contrast between light and dark preserves the character of its iconic silhouette.

title: Ribbed Organic Form
description: A warm-toned ovoid formed from finely interlocking ribs. The dense surface opens into an intricate network of organic cavities.
alt: Ribbed Organic Form by Patrick Cabral
